provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 3 tokens differ only in accent, ligature or orthography as the 1862 text layer renders them (sunt/sunt;; et/et,; D6minum./Dominum); 1862 text layer reads 'T\Eus,' where the 1962 prints 'Deus,'; 1862 text layer reads 'proc6dunt,' where the 1962 prints 'procedunt,'; 1862 text layer reads 'largfre' where the 1962 prints 'largire'; 1862 text layer reads 'suppllcitus' where the 1962 prints 'supplicibus'; 1862 text layer reads 'cogit6mus,' where the 1962 prints 'cogitemus,'; 1862 text layer reads 'inspir' where the 1962 prints 'inspirante,'; 1862 text layer reads 'quse' where the 1962 prints 'quae'; 1862 text layer reads 'faci' where the 1962 prints 'faciamus.'; 1862 text layer emits 3 stray fragment(s) at line breaks ('/', 'nte,', 'mus.'); 1962 writes the conclusion out at length (nostrum.); the 1862 prints the shorter cue. Corroboration: 1922 Tours Mame, printed p. 379 (artifact PDF p. 493), text layer, lines 36296-36305: 23 of 23 tokens match exactly or in orthography, 0 word-level difference(s).
